context:
Deliver a one-week proof of concept for Cover's Home Building Regulatory Engine.
The primary brief is docs/project_1771987446618.pdf.
Target architects and engineers assessing residential parcels in the City of Los Angeles.
Use Python for the backend and JavaScript/TypeScript for the frontend.
Prioritize regulatory ingestion and synthesis, citations, traceability, and explainability.
Clearly separate verified parcel data from interpretations and inferred conclusions.
Use a small, well-reasoned subset of regulations; do not imply complete regulatory coverage.
Reasonable mock data is permitted by the brief and must be clearly identified.
Ponytail guidance in AGENTS.md applies: choose the smallest complete implementation.
